metadata.description: Curated skills for Claude Code: deep research, code simplification, and dev-loop cycles; codebase-architecture analysis/extract chain.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Source-triaged research engine with local-first evidence, grok-search freshness checks, Context7/API verification, tiered model pinning (sonnet/haiku agents for external research, parent model for synthesis), deep-fetch, content refinement, and flexible output: terminal, file, or skillwiki vault integration with schema-compatible follow-up queueing. Spawnable as a subagent (model: sonnet) via deep-research:deep-research. v2.4.3: latest-by-default source triage, grok-search freshness, and Freshness & Verification Status reporting.

plugins.name: simplify
plugins.description: Code review for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Generic single-pass PRD + skillwiki dev cycle engine. v1.26.24: planning and decision agents inherit the invoking parent model while research and mechanical workers remain on Sonnet; immutable plugin payload/version enforcement, exact host-aware cache diagnostics, platform-correct fresh-session recovery, deterministic write preflight, and typed verification dispatch. Includes preflight prep mode, investigate, SkillWiki vault workflows, simplify review, CI health gates, and main-first release verification.

plugins.name: agent-plugin-porter
plugins.description: Guide for using agent-plugin-porter to convert Claude Code plugins into Codex and Agy/Gemini packages, verify generated output, install Codex personal-marketplace packages, and prepare npm publish/release workflow checks.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: hermes-cli
plugins.description: Hermes Agent CLI commands reference — full terminal command surface for hermes-agent by NousResearch

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Playwright CLI setup and browser automation with a user-level chrome-debug command, project config initialization, attach-first global Chrome default-user profile, browser-worker, and Linux/LXC support

plugins.name: rtk-output-design
plugins.description: RTK-inspired output contract for building token-efficient CLI, skill, hook, and script developer tools.

plugins.name: host-backup-restore
plugins.description: Host-level backup and restore with profile system (presets + custom YAML profiles), model-aware agents (sonnet worker), post-discovery research, and skillwiki infrastructure capture. v3.6.4: explicit SSH/Tailscale identity restore for post-reinstall hosts, with safety snapshots, ca-certificates handling, and SSH validation. Supports Caddy domains, databases, systemd services, Hermes snapshots, and restore target pre-inspection.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentless plan/design interview skills adapted from Matt Pocock's grilling, with inline cross-platform question style. v1.0.0: packages both skill names for direct invocation.

plugins.name: codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Codebase analysis and reimplementation skill chain: router, deep-module design vocabulary, architecture analyze/extract (wiki-first markdown to projects/{slug}/architecture else repo docs/architecture), deepening HTML/MD reviews, and architecture-to-spec PRDs. Distilled from mattpocock design skills + architecture-explainer playbook. v0.1.1: vocabulary fix (module extracts), YAGNI improve, C4 evidence, slug algorithm, router skill, Codex openai.yaml.

plugins.name: grok-resume
plugins.description: Source-faithful Grok Build resume-codex and resume-claude skills with the complete inert session reader, raw source snapshots, and cross-platform wrapper compatibility.
